title: HiFi-KPI: A Dataset for Hierarchical KPI Extraction from Earnings Filings
abstract: arXiv:2502.15411v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Accurate tagging of earnings reports can yield significant short-term returns for stakeholders. The machine-readable inline eXtensible Business Reporting Language (iXBRL) is mandated for public financial filings. Yet, its complex, fine-grained taxonomy limits the cross-company transferability of tagged Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). To address this, we introduce the Hierarchical Financial Key Performance Indicator (HiFi-KPI) dataset, a large-scale corpus of 1.65M paragraphs and 198k unique, hierarchically organized labels linked to iXBRL taxonomies. HiFi-KPI supports multiple tasks and we evaluate three: KPI classification, KPI extraction, and structured KPI extraction. For rapid evaluation, we also release HiFi-KPI-Lite, a manually curated 8K paragraph subset. translated_title: HiFi-KPI：用于从财务申报文件中提取层级关键绩效指标的数据集
translated_abstract: 准确标注财务报告可以为利益相关者带来显著的短期回报。机器可读的内联可扩展商业报告语言（iXBRL）是公开财务申报的强制要求。然而，其复杂且细粒度的分类法限制了跨公司关键绩效指标（KPI）标注的可迁移性。为解决这一问题，我们引入了层级财务关键绩效指标（HiFi-KPI）数据集，这是一个包含165万段落和19.8万个唯一、层级组织标签的大规模语料库，这些标签与iXBRL分类法相关联。HiFi-KPI支持多种任务，我们评估了其中三种：KPI分类、KPI提取和结构化KPI提取。为了快速评估，我们还发布了HiFi-KPI-Lite，这是一个手动精选的8000段落子集。在HiFi-KPI-Lite上的基线测试显示，基于编码器的模型在分类任务上实现了超过0.906的宏F1分数，而大型语言模型（LLMs）在结构化提取上达到0.440的F1分数。
tldr: 本文提出了HiFi-KPI数据集，包含165万段落和19.8万个层级标签，用于财务申报中的KPI分类、提取和结构化提取任务，并展示了基线模型性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the HiFi-KPI dataset, containing 1.65M paragraphs and 198k hierarchical labels, for KPI classification, extraction, and structured extraction from earnings filings, with baseline results reported.
